title: Sunday · the cannery from the dock
logline: The cannery across the water from Gully's dock in August evening light, its chimney, its rust, a gull line on its ridge. The dock's end in the foreground with two coffees on the planks.

panels.composition: Tier 1: from the dock's end: the bay, and across it the cannery in evening light, chimney, rust streaks, a line of gulls on the ridge.

panels.name: Across

panels.composition: Tier 2: the dock planks in the foreground, two paper coffee cups, nobody's hands.

panels.composition: Tier 3: the cannery going dark, the chimney against the last light. Held.
